title: Ringed Planet Flyby
prompt: A flyby of a banded gas giant with wide icy rings: the camera passes close to ring particles and rocks, the planet looming with the rings' shadow across its bands; a distant sun.
description: Use nested annuli and ring debris for scale during a close flyby under hard sunlight.
